headline: Results on 11 Nov: up 11.8% on the day, high +17.1%
why: Results filed at 13:52 with the price already up 6.3%. Most of the move came around the filing. Chasing after a 17% intraday high is the riskiest entry; wait for a base, not a headline.
source: NSE filing and live prices, 11 Nov

headline: Q2 profit up 11.8% on the year, flat on the quarter
why: Revenue Rs 1,827 cr (+8.9%), profit Rs 172 cr, EPS 15.01 against 13.43. The analyst estimate is not available, so a beat or miss cannot be stated. Watch whether the price holds above the filing-time level.

headline: Power Grid synchronous condenser order
why: Rs 600 to 900 cr over 35 months is about 2% of a year's revenue. Too small to move the stock by itself.

headline: Lowest bidder for a Rs 901 cr NBCC job in Srinagar
why: L-1 means the lowest bid, not a confirmed award. About 10% of yearly revenue if won. Wait for the award letter.
